# CG-REQ-034: Request composition widened

An anyOf branch, a discriminated oneOf branch was added, or a non-mergeable allOf branch removed.

**Why it matters:** More alternatives (or fewer conjuncts) widen accepted requests.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.variantAdded`, `schema.variantRemoved` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> The {composition} composition of {where} accepts more payloads.
>
> Existing consumers are unaffected.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: anyOf branch added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: string}, {type: boolean}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: string}, {type: boolean}, {type: integer}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. The anyOf composition of POST /x: the request body (application/json) accepts more payloads.

### Does not fire: variant removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}, {type: boolean}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
